comment: Line budgets per file type. soft = warning (plan a split); hard = test failure (split before extending). Grounded in published agent-workflow guidance: source files ~500 lines max so a single read stays cheap; agent-facing docs ~200-300 lines because instruction adherence degrades as context grows.

docs/STATE.md.note: Fixed-size current state; overwritten each checkpoint, never grown. The 40-line cap is the point.

docs/HARNESS.md.note: Process reference, read on demand rather than every session.

supabase/seed.sql.note: Sample data, not logic; length tracks the number of seeded rows. Exit plan: split per domain (seed/ directory, one file per schema domain) if it nears this cap.

supabase/schema/30_work.sql.note: The work-items domain (items, phases, dependencies, notes) in one file; split by sub-table if it nears the hard limit.

assets/css/components.css.note: Over soft. Exit plan: shed badge and table styles into components-data.css, linked wherever components.css is.

assets/css/layout.css.note: Over soft. Exit plan: the nav and page-head blocks are the split seam when it grows further.

assets/css/pages.css.note: Just over soft; split per page section if it grows.

assets/css/tokens.css.note: Design tokens plus dark-theme overrides; inherently long, not logic.

assets/css/roadmap.css.note: Over soft since the bug-icon toggle and the export dropdown. Exit plan: shed the print @media block into a roadmap-print.css.

assets/js/pages/roadmap-views.js.note: Over soft (shared helpers + placement model). The Timeline layout (roadmap-views-timeline.js), cascade family (roadmap-views-cascade.js), exec board (roadmap-views-exec.js) and Detailed breakdown (roadmap-views-breakdown.js) are all split out; the context/placement helpers are the next seam if it grows again.

assets/js/pages/roadmap.js.note: Over soft since the stage-toggle wiring on the board headers. The drawer wiring is the extract-to-a-module seam - pull it into roadmap-drawer.js before extending further.

assets/js/pages/roadmap-detail.js.note: Over soft since the drawer began surfacing the full stored context. Exit plan: move the JSON/CSV export builders into a roadmap-detail-export.js sharing the drawer helpers.

assets/js/pages/backlog.js.note: Over soft since the CSV export. Exit plan: move the CSV record builder and columns into a backlog-export.js sharing App.csvFromRows.

assets/js/pages/reference.js.note: Over soft; loadSpec/hydrate could move to a reference-data.js.

tests/unit/roadmap-views.test.js.note: Over soft: one dataset (tests/lib/roadmap.js) drives the level/layout benchmarks together. The custom-view and department-filter cases are already split into roadmap-views-custom.test.js; the exec-board cases are the next split seam.

docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.note: Architecture reference, read on demand rather than every session.

docs/ROADMAP.md.note: Roadmap process reference, read on demand.
